description: External verified native-scene asset/proof binding. It is not a source of observations; the runner verifies map/assets/lanes and captures actual behavior. Native proofs must exist with exact SHA256.
required_fields: incoming_topology:all native lane links and intersection IDs
device_governance:explicit native actor/lane/region IDs and physical proof
incoming_lane_extent_m:[at least230m per incoming route] for sight capture
forbidden: Changing frozen comparison variables to fit available map
Empty or guessed physical proof records
Using a public-authority assumption to substitute for an absent physical sign
